notes: Variant WLC.JER.2.24.v004 selected r00-base for s006-s007; the projection is נַפְשָׁהּ, which the ASV compresses to 'her desire', so נֶפֶשׁ is unrepresented and no rule 53 case arises.
The supplied 'that' at t008 is added on the same footing as JER.2.6's: an asyndetic finite relative clause with no אֲשֶׁר and no article.
